title: the probe-carry proof's live-bus poke is marked as testing
intention: The probe-carry proof's live-bus poke carries the testing mark, so when no one can take its bounce the bus throws it away instead of raising a live trouble.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: 8 live troubles mail-testing-ad7caca4d54c-recipient-*-has-no-receiver came from test_probe_carry.py's end-to-end tooth. It posts an unmarked body under testing-marked names, and the bus decides disposal from the mark in the body only (b3386f431ae3).
traces_to: Law 7: the trouble lane is a record of truth, and test debris there crowds out real errors. ad7caca4d54c intended every name and body marked as testing.
how: test_probe_carry.py's _TestingBus.post stamps testing_mark.mark('ad7caca4d54c') on every body, as test_console_pane.py and test_chat_pane.py do. A red-first proof records the tooth's posts on the live bus and reads each back by envelope id.

clauses.claim: every letter the end-to-end tooth posts on the live bus carries a well-formed testing mark, read back by its envelope id
the end-to-end tooth still passes: one post, the carrier's text intact

decisions.text: D1: _TestingBus in test_probe_carry.py gains a post that stamps testing_mark on the body.
D2: a red-first proof, one tooth per clause, wraps the live bus's client and records each post.

measured.saw: the new proof red 2/2 on origin/main's test_probe_carry.py and green 2/2 at 0159469cb; test_probe_carry 17/17
measured.how: bin/cairn test --exec over the proofs in wt-pcm
